description: Utility module for handling ANGLE graphics format conversions, including loading format tables, parsing format identifiers, and generating format-specific data initializers and conversion functions.

methods.name: get_angle_format_map_abs_path
methods.description: Returns the absolute path to the 'angle_format_map.json' file based on current script location.

methods.name: reject_duplicate_keys
methods.description: Filters duplicate keys in a list of key-value pairs, raising an error on duplicates.

methods.name: load_json
methods.description: Loads JSON data from a file, applying duplicate key rejection.

methods.name: load_forward_table
methods.description: Loads a JSON file and returns a dictionary mapping GL formats to ANGLE formats.

methods.name: load_inverse_table
methods.description: Loads a JSON file and returns a dictionary mapping ANGLE formats to GL formats.

methods.name: load_without_override
methods.description: Loads the default angle format map without overrides.

methods.name: load_with_override
methods.description: Loads the angle format map with an override JSON file.

methods.name: get_all_angle_formats
methods.description: Returns all ANGLE format identifiers available in the inverse table.

methods.name: get_component_type
methods.description: Determines the component type (e.g., 'float', 'uint') from a format ID string.

methods.name: get_channel_tokens
methods.description: Extracts channel tokens (e.g., 'R8', 'G16') from a format ID.

methods.name: get_channels
methods.description: Returns a string of lowercased channel identifiers from a format ID.

methods.name: get_bits
methods.description: Returns a dictionary of channel bits (e.g., {'R':8, 'G':8}) from a format ID.

methods.name: get_format_info
methods.description: Returns component type, bits, and channels for a format ID.

methods.name: gl_format_channels
methods.description: Maps internal format strings to channel arrangements like 'rgb', 'bgra'.

methods.name: get_internal_format_initializer
methods.description: Generates code for initializing internal format data based on format and ID.

methods.name: get_format_gl_type
methods.description: Determines the OpenGL type string (e.g., 'GLfloat', 'GLubyte') for a format.

methods.name: get_vertex_copy_function
methods.description: Returns code for copying vertex data between formats.
